docket_entries.description: PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FEE FOR SERVICE: $150.00 SERVED APR-12-2017, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT HARTY, PATRICK

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-01-2017 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUN-21-2017 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PRIOR TO THE CALLING OF THE CASE PARTIES REACHED AN AGREEMENT. THE DEFENDANT GAVE THE PLAINTIFF A CHECK FOR $3650.00 AND AGREES TO PAY THE REMAINING AMOUNT OF $2000.00 WITHIN 45 DAYS. THE PLAINTIFF AGREES TO FIX A LEAK AT THE DEFENDANT'S PROPERTY WITHIN 30 DAYS. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE IS DEFECTIVE. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. PLAINTIFF PANFILO ARMAS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT PATRICK HERTY IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHAEL MAU; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $100.00 FILED BY ARMAS, PANFILO DBA AMERICAN ROOFING COMPANY AS TO DEFENDANT HARTY, PATRICK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-01-2017 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED.
